unlisted_practices: Combine historical clinical trial data with real-world data using machine learning clustering to identify optimal baseline characteristic distributions for trial recruitment.
Integrate real-world data into Bayesian clustering frameworks as priors to model between-trial heterogeneity.

Monitor baseline characteristics of enrolled trial participants in real time against predefined benchmarks using screening logs and interim analyses, and adjust recruitment proactively if subgroups are underrepresented.
Carefully select and validate the training data used for machine learning models, given their dependence on data quality and completeness.
Ensure transparency and adherence to regulatory guidance when using black-box machine learning algorithms.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/letter proposing methodological and governance approaches to using machine learning and historical trial data to optimize clinical trial recruitment and generalizability.
